title: Four seasons
decides: One pictured product in four separate places, 20 s: one call or one call for each idea?
setting: A perfume advertisement photographed like a still life: soft natural light, shallow depth of field, one slow camera move in each scene.

subjects.words: The perfume: a clear rectangular glass bottle with clear liquid, a square brushed-grey cap and the words MOCKUP FRAGRANCE in black serif letters printed on the glass; no label panel, no box

beats.text: Spring. The bottle stands on a mossy stone under a cherry tree. Pink petals drift down past it.
Summer. The bottle stands in pale sand on a bright beach. Sunlight sparkles on the glass and a wave slides in behind it.
Autumn. The bottle stands on a wooden bench among red and orange fallen leaves. One leaf lands beside it.
Winter. The bottle stands in fresh snow. Snowflakes fall and frost edges the glass.

variants.name: medium-only
variants.why: user 2026-11-06: cut only on a change of medium (card, scene, still) or the length cap; cap cuts balanced (10 + 10)

checks: Spring, summer, autumn, winter, in order, each once
Same bottle in all four: clear glass, grey cap, MOCKUP FRAGRANCE letters, no box
No two seasons in one frame
